## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`) — see [DCO](../CONTRIBUTING.md#developer-certificate-of-origin-dco)
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] If this touches routing/fallback: tests prove no double charge is possible
- [ ] Docs and `CHANGELOG.md` (Unreleased) updated if behavior changed
- [ ] No real secrets or personal data in code, tests, or fixtures
